The main affiliate of ISIS in Nigeria is ISWAP, which originated as Boko Haram in 2002 to oppose Western influence and predates ISIS. Since the mid-2010s a small group called Lakurawa, which later began coordinating with ISIS’s ISSP affiliate, began operating in Sokoto state along the northwestern Nigeria-Niger border.
